indexEntry.body:
Mature Students

A student who has been away from formal education for more than two years may apply as a mature student. Although the University of Waterloo does not automatically offer admission to mature applicants, the admissions committee carefully considers previous academic records, résumés, and other biographical material before determining a candidate's suitability for university studies. Students must be able to demonstrate recent academic proficiency in mathematics at the senior high school level.
